title: adaptor.json
body:
{
  "version": "schemaxis.aseprite/1",
  "declarations": "schemaxis.adaptors.aseprite.adaptor:DECLARATIONS",
  "runtimeFamily": "1.3.x",
  "executables": [
    "aseprite"
  ],
  "execution": "batch sprite authoring and captured PNG cel import with native reopening; editable sprites and sprite sheets",
  "keywords": [
    "pixel art",
    "sprites",
    "layers",
    "animation"
  ],
  "executionCapabilities": {
    "modes": [
      "batch"
    ],
    "mpi": false
  },
  "id": "aseprite",
  "adaptor": "schemaxis.adaptors.aseprite.adaptor",
  "consoleCapabilities": {
    "authoredSessions": true,
    "multipleDocuments": true,
    "liveGeometry": false,
    "visualReferences": true,
    "geometryReferences": false,
    "imagePixelReferences": true,
    "imageReferenceRequirement": "a current native PNG preview; no inferred object identity",
    "nativeEditReverseSync": false
  },
  "consoleTemplate": {
    "version": "schemaxis.aseprite/1",
    "nodes": [],
    "output": null
  },
  "consoleOutput": true,
  "nativeExtension": ".aseprite",
  "consoleHooks": {},
  "cliOptions": [
    {
      "flag": "--aseprite",
      "dest": "aseprite",
      "help": "Explicit aseprite executable"
    }
  ],
  "routes": {
    "schemaxis.aseprite/1": {
      "module": "schemaxis.adaptors.aseprite.adaptor",
      "workflow": true,
      "scheduled": true,
      "compose": true,
      "graph": false,
      "timeBatches": false,
      "schemaName": "aseprite",
      "acceptedArtifacts": [
        "image"
      ],
      "schema": "schemaxis.adaptors.aseprite.adaptor:schema",
      "hooks": {
        "reusableInputs": "schemaxis.adaptors.aseprite.integration:reusableInputs"
      },
      "expand": "plannedNodes",
      "schemaOrder": 6
    }
  },
  "sections": {},
  "optionSchema": "schemaxis.adaptors.aseprite.adaptor:options_schema",
  "capabilities": "schemaxis.adaptors.aseprite.capabilities:catalogue"
}
